item.title: Japanese Iced Coffee Recipe: Flash-Brewed Over Ice (The Fastest Iced Coffee Method)
item.description: Japanese iced coffee is hot pour-over brewed directly onto ice — finished in 4 minutes, brighter and cleaner than cold brew. Full recipe with the 1:15 brew + 1/3 ice ratio, why flash-brewing preserves aromatics, and Japanese vs cold brew comparison.
